integrity: Finite-state proof uses exact integer max-plus recurrence, complete reachable-state closure, and a standalone standard-library verifier. Finite direct enumeration is corroborative, not the general proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns ordinary open two-row ladders, not wider or periodic grids. Historical priority remains provisional; independent mathematical validation is not performed.
title: A complete six-pattern classification of upper-dominating sets in ladders
